words.enDefinition: a small countertop oven that also makes toast

examples.en: I use the toaster oven for small portions when my housemates need the main oven.
examples.zh: 室友用大烤箱时，我用「台式小烤箱」做少量食物。

examples.en: The studio came with a toaster oven large enough for two slices of pizza.
examples.zh: 单间公寓配了个「台式小烤箱」，大小够放两片比萨。

collocations: toast bread in a toaster oven
reheat leftovers in a toaster oven

words.enDefinition: a cooktop that heats compatible pans using magnetic fields

examples.en: My old frying pan doesn't work on the induction hob in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我的旧煎锅用不了我们公用厨房的「电磁炉灶面」。

examples.en: The landlord showed us the induction hob when we toured the newly renovated flat.
examples.zh: 我们看那套刚翻新的公寓时，房东给我们看了「电磁炉灶面」。

collocations: an induction hob on the island

words.enDefinition: a smooth glass-ceramic cooktop heated by elements underneath

examples.en: The ceramic hob looks like an induction cooktop, but the heaters glow beneath the surface.
examples.zh: 这个「陶瓷电炉灶面」看起来像电磁灶，但面板下的发热元件会发亮。

examples.en: We spotted a mark on the ceramic hob while checking our new flat's inventory.
examples.zh: 我们核对新公寓的房屋清单时，发现「陶瓷电炉灶面」上有道印子。

collocations: a mark on the ceramic hob

words.enDefinition: the flat cooking surface of a stove with gas burners

examples.en: The flat had a gas hob with four burners and a separate electric oven.
examples.zh: 这套公寓有一个四眼的「燃气灶面」，另配电烤箱。

examples.en: I asked the landlord whether the gas hob shown in the photos came with the flat.
examples.zh: 我问房东，照片上的「燃气灶面」是不是公寓自带的。

collocations: a pan on the gas hob

words.enDefinition: an appliance that brews coffee by dripping water through grounds

examples.en: Our drip coffee maker makes enough coffee for all three roommates before we leave for campus.
examples.zh: 「滴滤咖啡机」能在我们去学校前煮出够三个室友喝的咖啡。

examples.en: I bought a used drip coffee maker because the one in the kitchen belonged to my roommate.
examples.zh: 厨房那台是室友的，于是我买了一台二手「滴滤咖啡机」。

collocations: a filter for a drip coffee maker

words.enDefinition: a machine that crushes coffee beans into small particles

examples.en: The coffee grinder is noisy, so I usually make coffee after my flatmates wake up.
examples.zh: 「咖啡磨豆机」声音大，所以我通常等室友起床后再做咖啡。

examples.en: I tried the library café's beans at home with the coffee grinder on our kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 我用厨房架子上的「咖啡磨豆机」试了试图书馆咖啡店的豆子。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that brews coffee from sealed individual pods

examples.en: There's a capsule coffee machine in the student lounge, but you need to bring your own pods.
examples.zh: 学生休息区有一台「胶囊咖啡机」，不过得自己带胶囊。

examples.en: My housemate bought a capsule coffee machine that fits on our narrow kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 室友买了一台「胶囊咖啡机」，放得下我们家窄窄的厨房台面。

collocations: pods for a capsule coffee machine

words.enDefinition: a handheld appliance with blades dipped directly into food

examples.en: I used an immersion blender to make the squash soup smooth without transferring it.
examples.zh: 我用「手持搅拌棒」把南瓜汤打细，不用另换容器。

examples.en: My roommate brought an immersion blender from home for the soup we make on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我室友从家里带来一根「手持搅拌棒」，方便我们周日一起做汤。

collocations: blend soup with an immersion blender

words.enDefinition: a kitchen appliance that chops or slices food mechanically

examples.en: We borrowed a food processor to chop the vegetables for a big batch of salsa.
examples.zh: 我们借了台「食物料理机」切菜，好做一大份莎莎酱。

examples.en: The shared kitchen has a food processor, so I didn't buy one when I moved in.
examples.zh: 公用厨房有一台「食物料理机」，我入住时就没再买。

collocations: pulse food in a food processor

words.enDefinition: an appliance that mixes dough and bakes bread automatically

examples.en: My roommate uses a bread maker to make fresh bread for breakfast on the weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我室友用「面包机」做新鲜面包当早餐。

examples.en: The bread maker was too big for our shelf, so we kept it on the counter.
examples.zh: 「面包机」太大，架子放不下，我们就搁在台面上。

words.enDefinition: a motorized kitchen mixer that sits on a fixed base

examples.en: We used the stand mixer to mix enough cookie dough for everyone in our building.
examples.zh: 我们用「台式搅拌机」拌了面团，够给整栋楼的人做饼干。

examples.en: The stand mixer belongs to my roommate, but she lets me borrow it for baking.
examples.zh: 「台式搅拌机」是我室友的，不过她愿意借给我做烘焙。

words.enDefinition: a handheld appliance with beaters for mixing food

examples.en: I used a hand mixer to whip cream for the cake we took to dinner.
examples.zh: 我用「手持打蛋器」打发了奶油，抹到我们带去聚餐的蛋糕上。

examples.en: We found a hand mixer in the kitchen drawer while looking for the measuring cups.
examples.zh: 找量杯的时候，我们在厨房抽屉里发现了一个「手持打蛋器」。

collocations: beat eggs with a hand mixer

words.enDefinition: a jug that filters water as it passes through

examples.en: I bought a slim water filter pitcher that fits on the top shelf of our fridge.
examples.zh: 我买了个窄身的「滤水壶」，放得进冰箱最上层。

examples.en: We keep a water filter pitcher in the kitchen so everyone has cold filtered water.
examples.zh: 我们在厨房放了一个「滤水壶」，这样大家都有过滤过的凉水喝。

collocations: a cartridge for a water filter pitcher

words.enDefinition: an electric pot for cooking food slowly over hours

examples.en: I made stew in the slow cooker and shared it with my flatmates after class.
examples.zh: 我用「慢炖锅」做了一锅炖菜，下课后和室友分着吃了。

examples.en: The slow cooker is useful when we want enough soup for several lunches this week.
examples.zh: 这周想多做点汤带午饭时，「慢炖锅」就派上用场了。

collocations: cook stew in a slow cooker

words.enDefinition: a sealed pot that cooks food quickly under pressure

examples.en: My aunt gave me a pressure cooker when I moved into my first flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进第一套公寓时，姨妈送了我一口「压力锅」。

examples.en: The pressure cooker came with a recipe booklet that included several simple dishes with beans.
examples.zh: 这口「压力锅」附带一本食谱，有几道简单的豆类菜。

words.enDefinition: an electric cooking pot with several different programs

examples.en: We wanted a multicooker because our room has very little space for kitchen appliances.
examples.zh: 我们房间没多少地方放厨房电器，所以想买个「多功能电煮锅」。

examples.en: The multicooker has separate settings for rice and soup, which I use most often.
examples.zh: 「多功能电煮锅」有煮饭和煲汤两种独立模式，也是我最常用的。

words.enDefinition: an appliance with heated plates that presses and toasts sandwiches

examples.en: We used the sandwich press to make quick cheese sandwiches between our evening lectures.
examples.zh: 晚上两节课的间隙，我们用「热压三明治机」很快做好了奶酪三明治。

examples.en: The sandwich press went back in the cupboard after my roommate had finished making lunch.
examples.zh: 室友做完午饭后，把「热压三明治机」放回了橱柜。

collocations: toast bread in a sandwich press

words.enDefinition: an appliance with patterned plates for cooking waffle batter

examples.en: My flatmate brought out the waffle iron so we could make breakfast together on Sunday.
examples.zh: 室友拿出了「华夫饼机」，这样周日我们就能一起做早餐。

examples.en: I lent my waffle iron to the students upstairs for their weekend brunch.
examples.zh: 我把「华夫饼机」借给楼上的同学做周末早午餐。

words.enDefinition: an appliance that cooks or heats food using microwaves

examples.en: Our floor has a microwave oven in the common room for reheating lunches after class.
examples.zh: 我们楼层的公共休息室有台「微波炉」，下课后可以热午饭。

examples.en: I bought a smaller bowl because the old one barely fit in the microwave oven.
examples.zh: 原来的碗勉强能放进「微波炉」，于是我买了个小一点的。

collocations: heat soup in a microwave oven

words.enDefinition: an oven with a fan that circulates hot air

examples.en: The kitchen has a convection oven, so the fan runs during some baking programs.
examples.zh: 厨房配有「热风循环烤箱」，因此部分烘烤程序会开风扇。

examples.en: My roommate chose the convection oven for baking two trays of cookies at once.
examples.zh: 我室友选用「热风循环烤箱」，一次烤两盘饼干。

words.enDefinition: a unit above a stove that removes airborne cooking fumes

examples.en: The range hood is quite loud, but the kitchen smells much better after we fry onions.
examples.zh: 「抽油烟机」声音挺大，但我们炒洋葱之后，厨房的味道好闻多了。

examples.en: I asked whether the range hood vents outside when the landlord showed us the kitchen.
examples.zh: 房东带我们参观厨房时，我问「抽油烟机」的排气是不是通到室外。

words.enDefinition: the lamp illuminating the inside of an oven

examples.en: I switched on the oven light to see whether the cookies were starting to brown.
examples.zh: 我开了「烤箱照明灯」，看饼干是不是开始上色了。

examples.en: The oven light lets me check the cake without opening the door halfway through baking.
examples.zh: 有了「烤箱照明灯」，烤到一半时我不用开门即可查看蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: a removable metal shelf that supports food inside an oven

examples.en: My flatmate needed the top oven rack free for a tray of vegetables.
examples.zh: 室友要空出上层的「烤箱烤架」，放一盘蔬菜。

examples.en: The baking dish barely fit on the bottom oven rack in our small kitchen oven.
examples.zh: 我们的厨房烤箱很小，烤盘勉强放得进最下层的「烤箱烤架」。

collocations: place a tray on the oven rack

words.enDefinition: a device that signals when a set cooking period ends

examples.en: I set the oven timer for the cookies before going back to my reading.
examples.zh: 我给饼干设好「烤箱定时器」，然后接着看书。

examples.en: We heard the oven timer from the living room just as the first guests arrived.
examples.zh: 第一批客人刚到，我们就在客厅听见「烤箱定时器」响了。

words.enDefinition: heat a cooking appliance before putting food inside

examples.en: I usually preheat the oven while I finish mixing the dough for the rolls.
examples.zh: 我通常一边把小面包的面团和好，一边「预热」烤箱。

examples.en: The recipe says to preheat the oven before putting the vegetables inside to roast.
examples.zh: 食谱说，放蔬菜进去烤之前要先「预热」烤箱。

words.enDefinition: cook food directly under a strong heat source

examples.en: The recipe asks us to broil the cheese topping until it begins to turn golden.
examples.zh: 食谱说，要「用上火烤」最上面的芝士层，直到开始变成金黄色。

examples.en: My roommate likes to broil the bread briefly to finish our open sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我室友喜欢把敞口三明治上的面包短暂「用上火烤」一下。

words.enDefinition: a mode for thawing frozen food before cooking

examples.en: Our microwave has a defrost setting that I use for the fruit I freeze.
examples.zh: 我们这台微波炉有「解冻档」，我会用来解冻自己冻的水果。

examples.en: I looked for the defrost setting because the bag of frozen berries had stuck together.
examples.zh: 那袋冻浆果粘成了一块，我就找了一下「解冻档」。

words.enDefinition: a device that turns food continuously while it cooks

examples.en: The oven has a rotisserie, although we've only used it for two Sunday dinners.
examples.zh: 这台烤箱有「旋转烤叉装置」，不过我们只在两次周日晚饭用过。

examples.en: My flatmate read the manual because she had never used a rotisserie before.
examples.zh: 我室友以前没用过「旋转烤叉装置」，于是翻看了说明书。

words.enDefinition: a gentle warming mode for letting dough rise

examples.en: We used the proofing setting because the kitchen was too cold for the dough to rise.
examples.zh: 厨房太冷，面团发不起来，我们就用了「面团发酵档」。

examples.en: I looked for a proofing setting on the oven when I started baking my own bread.
examples.zh: 我开始自己烤面包时，在烤箱上找了找有没有「面团发酵档」。

words.enDefinition: a mode that keeps cooked food warm until served

examples.en: The cooker switched to its keep-warm setting just before my housemates came home for dinner.
examples.zh: 室友到家吃饭前，锅刚切换到「保温档」。

examples.en: I used the keep-warm setting while we waited for the rest of the meal to finish.
examples.zh: 等其余菜做好期间，我用了「保温档」。

words.enDefinition: a control for setting how dark toast becomes

examples.en: I turned down the browning control because I prefer my toast lightly browned at breakfast.
examples.zh: 我把「烤色调节」调低了，因为早餐的吐司我喜欢烤得浅一些。

examples.en: My roommate explained the browning control when I asked why one setting made darker toast.
examples.zh: 我问为什么某一档烤出来的吐司更深，室友给我解释了「烤色调节」。

words.enDefinition: the rotating plate that turns food inside a microwave

examples.en: The large plate wouldn't sit flat on the turntable in our little microwave.
examples.zh: 我们的微波炉很小，大盘子没法平放在「微波炉转盘」上。

examples.en: I took the turntable out to wash off the soup that had spilled.
examples.zh: 我把「微波炉转盘」拿出来，洗掉上面洒的汤。

collocations: place a bowl on the turntable

words.enDefinition: a marked area on a cooktop that heats a pan

examples.en: The largest cooking zone on our hob is wide enough for my big frying pan.
examples.zh: 我们灶面的最大一个「灶面加热区」，放得下我的大煎锅。

examples.en: My roommate pointed out which cooking zone was active on the new cooktop's display.
examples.zh: 室友指着新灶面的显示屏，告诉我哪个「灶面加热区」在工作。

words.enDefinition: a signal that a cooking surface is still hot

examples.en: The residual heat indicator stayed on after I turned off the cooktop in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 我关了厨房的灶面后，「余热指示灯」还亮着。

examples.en: My flatmate recognized the residual heat indicator because our previous cooktop used the same symbol.
examples.zh: 以前的灶面用了同样的符号，所以我室友认出了「余热指示灯」。

collocations: a cooking zone's residual heat indicator

words.enDefinition: a sensor inserted into food to measure its temperature

examples.en: The oven has a temperature probe that shows the temperature inside whatever we're roasting.
examples.zh: 这台烤箱配了「测温探针」，能显示正在烤的食物的内部温度。

examples.en: My roommate lent me a temperature probe when we cooked a roast for our guests.
examples.zh: 我们烤肉招待客人时，室友借给我一根「测温探针」。

words.enDefinition: a deep freezer with a lid on the top

examples.en: Our landlord keeps a chest freezer in the garage for food from the shared garden.
examples.zh: 房东在车库放了个「卧式冷冻柜」，存从公用菜园收来的食材。

examples.en: We chose a chest freezer that would fit under the basement window without blocking it.
examples.zh: 我们选了个能放在地下室窗户下面、又不会挡住窗的「卧式冷冻柜」。

collocations: store food in a chest freezer

words.enDefinition: a freezer with front-opening doors and interior shelves

examples.en: The upright freezer has shelves, so each roommate can see what food is theirs.
examples.zh: 「立式冷冻柜」有分层架，每个室友都能看清哪些食物是自己的。

examples.en: We measured the alcove before buying a secondhand upright freezer for the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们给公用厨房买二手「立式冷冻柜」前，先量了凹进去的那块地方。

words.enDefinition: a unit with separate sections for chilling and freezing

examples.en: The fridge freezer in our new flat has a generous lower section for frozen food.
examples.zh: 我们新公寓的「冷藏冷冻一体冰箱」下面有一块挺大的空间，可以放冷冻食品。

examples.en: We checked the door clearance before ordering a fridge freezer for our narrow kitchen.
examples.zh: 给窄厨房订购「冷藏冷冻一体冰箱」前，我们先核对了开门空间。

words.enDefinition: a small refrigerator designed for a room or countertop

examples.en: My dorm room came with a mini fridge that could hold a few drinks.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍配了个「迷你冰箱」，能放几瓶饮料。

examples.en: I left enough space next to the desk for a mini fridge of my own.
examples.zh: 我在书桌旁边留了够放一台自己用的「迷你冰箱」的空间。

collocations: store drinks in a mini fridge
fit a mini fridge under a desk

words.enDefinition: the section of a refrigerator used for freezing food

examples.en: Our freezer compartment is so small that two boxes of frozen pizza fill it.
examples.zh: 我们的「冷冻隔室」太小，两盒冷冻比萨就塞满了。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps one bag of peas in the freezer compartment for quick dinners.
examples.zh: 室友在「冷冻隔室」备了一袋豌豆，方便做简单的晚饭。

collocations: store food in the freezer compartment

words.enDefinition: a device that freezes water into cubes or pieces

examples.en: The ice maker in our shared kitchen was useful when we hosted a summer party.
examples.zh: 我们办夏日聚会时，公用厨房里的「制冰机」很有用。

examples.en: My student flat came with a refrigerator and a built-in ice maker for drinks.
examples.zh: 我的学生公寓配了冰箱和内置的「制冰机」，可以给饮料加冰。

words.enDefinition: a refrigerator drawer designed to keep produce fresh

examples.en: I put the lettuce in the crisper drawer to keep it from going limp.
examples.zh: 我把生菜放进「蔬果保鲜抽屉」，免得叶子蔫了。

examples.en: My roommates keep fruit separate from vegetables by using a different crisper drawer in the fridge.
examples.zh: 室友用不同的「蔬果保鲜抽屉」把冰箱里的水果和蔬菜分开放。

collocations: store lettuce in the crisper drawer

words.enDefinition: a shelf that can be installed at different heights

examples.en: We moved an adjustable shelf to fit a tall jug in our shared fridge.
examples.zh: 我们挪了下「可调层架」，好把一个高水壶放进共用冰箱。

examples.en: The landlord left an extra adjustable shelf in the cupboard after installing the new refrigerator.
examples.zh: 房东装好新冰箱后，在橱柜里留了一块备用的「可调层架」。

collocations: a fridge with an adjustable shelf

words.enDefinition: a holder that keeps bottles organized inside a refrigerator

examples.en: I put the juice on the bottle rack so the middle shelf stayed free.
examples.zh: 我把果汁放在「瓶架」上，这样中间那层就空出来了。

examples.en: We removed the bottle rack temporarily to make room for the cake my roommate brought.
examples.zh: 为了放室友带来的蛋糕，我们暂时取下了「瓶架」。

collocations: put drinks on the bottle rack

words.enDefinition: designed to prevent frost from accumulating during normal use

examples.en: I chose a frost-free freezer because I'd had to defrost our old one by hand.
examples.zh: 我选了「免除霜」冷冻柜，因为旧的得我手动除霜。

examples.en: The frost-free model was slightly bigger, but it still fit in the student kitchen.
examples.zh: 「免除霜」款稍大一些，不过学生公寓的厨房还是放得下。

words.enDefinition: dry patches on frozen food caused by air exposure

examples.en: We found patches of freezer burn on the bread we'd forgotten in the freezer.
examples.zh: 我们在忘在冷冻柜里的面包上发现了几块「食物冷冻干斑」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to spot freezer burn on the leftover food we'd frozen.
examples.zh: 室友教我识别冻起来的剩菜上有没有「食物冷冻干斑」。

words.enDefinition: a flexible strip that seals the edges of an appliance door

examples.en: The landlord checked the door gasket when we noticed that the fridge door didn't close tightly.
examples.zh: 我们发现冰箱门关不严，房东检查了「门封条」。

examples.en: I pointed out the loose door gasket while showing the landlord around our kitchen.
examples.zh: 带房东看我们厨房时，我指出了松动的「门封条」。

words.enDefinition: a freezer mode that temporarily cools food more rapidly

examples.en: Our freezer has a quick freeze option for adding a lot of food at once.
examples.zh: 我们家的冷冻柜有「速冻功能」，适合一次放很多食物时用。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether quick freeze would switch itself off on the new freezer.
examples.zh: 室友问，新冷冻柜的「速冻功能」会不会自己关掉。

words.enDefinition: a replaceable part that removes impurities from drinking water

examples.en: The fridge display told us it was time for a new water filter cartridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱显示屏提示我们该换新的「滤水滤芯」了。

examples.en: I checked the model number before buying a water filter cartridge for our shared water jug.
examples.zh: 给共用的水壶买「滤水滤芯」前，我先确认了型号。

collocations: the life of a water filter cartridge

words.enDefinition: the higher sliding shelf that holds dishes inside a dishwasher

examples.en: We loaded mugs on the top rack to leave more room below for dinner plates.
examples.zh: 我们把马克杯放上「上层碗架」，给下面的餐盘多留点位置。

examples.en: My tall glasses wouldn't fit on the top rack unless I adjusted its height.
examples.zh: 我得调一下「上层碗架」的高度，不然自己的高玻璃杯放不进去。

collocations: place glasses on the top rack

words.enDefinition: the lower sliding shelf that holds dishes inside a dishwasher

examples.en: The frying pan fit on the bottom rack after I moved two large plates.
examples.zh: 我挪开两个大盘子后，煎锅就放得进「下层碗架」了。

examples.en: My roommate unloaded the bottom rack while I put away the glasses and mugs.
examples.zh: 室友在清空「下层碗架」，我则把玻璃杯和马克杯收起来。

collocations: put plates in the bottom rack

words.enDefinition: a removable dishwasher container for forks, knives, and spoons

examples.en: I lifted the cutlery basket out of the dishwasher to put the spoons away.
examples.zh: 我把「餐具篮」从洗碗机提出来，好把勺子收好。

examples.en: We use the cutlery basket for forks and keep long utensils on a separate shelf.
examples.zh: 我们把叉子放进「餐具篮」，长柄餐具则放另一层。

words.enDefinition: a shallow dishwasher shelf that holds utensils lying flat

examples.en: The new dishwasher has a cutlery tray instead of a basket in the lower rack.
examples.zh: 新洗碗机用的是「餐具平托盘」，不是放在下层的餐具篮。

examples.en: We put large spoons on the cutlery tray so they wouldn't fall through the rack.
examples.zh: 我们把大勺子放在「餐具平托盘」上，免得从架子的缝里掉下去。

words.enDefinition: a compartment that releases detergent during an appliance cycle

examples.en: I checked that the detergent dispenser had closed before starting the dishwasher after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后启动洗碗机前，我确认了「洗涤剂投放盒」已经扣好。

examples.en: My roommate couldn't find the detergent dispenser on the inside of the new dishwasher door.
examples.zh: 室友在新洗碗机的门内侧没找到「洗涤剂投放盒」。

words.enDefinition: a solid portion of detergent made for a dishwasher

examples.en: I found one dishwasher tablet left in the box under our kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 我发现厨房水槽下面的盒子里只剩一块「洗碗机清洁块」。

examples.en: My flatmate added a dishwasher tablet before running the machine after our dinner party.
examples.zh: 聚餐结束后，室友放了一块「洗碗机清洁块」才开机。

words.enDefinition: a liquid that helps water drain off dishes and glassware

examples.en: The rinse aid indicator came on, so I added it to our shared shopping list.
examples.zh: 「洗碗机漂洗剂」指示灯亮了，我把它加进了共用的购物清单。

examples.en: My housemate asked whether rinse aid was the same thing as regular dishwasher detergent.
examples.zh: 室友问，「洗碗机漂洗剂」和普通洗碗机洗涤剂是不是同一种东西。

words.enDefinition: coarse salt used to recharge a dishwasher's water softener

examples.en: The manual calls for dishwasher salt because our model has a built-in water softener.
examples.zh: 说明书上说要用「洗碗机专用盐」，因为我们这款内置软水器。

examples.en: I wrote dishwasher salt on the shopping list next to sponges and washing-up liquid.
examples.zh: 我在购物清单上写了「洗碗机专用盐」，就在海绵和洗洁精旁边。

words.enDefinition: a shorter program for washing lightly soiled items

examples.en: We ran a quick wash because we only needed clean cups before our guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前只要有干净杯子，所以我们选了「快速洗程序」。

examples.en: My roommate uses quick wash for lightly soiled dishes after making breakfast in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 室友在厨房做完早餐后，会用「快速洗程序」洗不太脏的餐具。

words.enDefinition: an appliance setting designed to reduce energy or water use

examples.en: Our dishwasher takes longer in eco mode, but we don't need the dishes right away.
examples.zh: 我们家的洗碗机用「节能模式」会花更久，不过我们不急着用餐具。

examples.en: My flatmate showed me how to tell whether eco mode was selected on the display.
examples.zh: 室友教我看显示屏，确认有没有选中「节能模式」。

collocations: run the dishwasher in eco mode

words.enDefinition: a powerful washing program for heavily soiled dishes or items

examples.en: We chose the intensive cycle after loading several greasy baking trays from the party.
examples.zh: 聚餐用的好几个烤盘都油乎乎的，装进去后我们选了「强力洗程序」。

examples.en: The manual recommends the intensive cycle for our heavy casserole dish when it has baked-on food.
examples.zh: 说明书建议，我们的大炖锅有烤结的食物残渣时用「强力洗程序」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that starts a machine after a set delay

examples.en: Am I reading this right, or did I accidentally set a delayed start for tomorrow?
examples.zh: 我没看错吧，还是我不小心设成了明天「延时启动」？

examples.en: I use the delayed start feature so the dishwasher doesn't run during our weekly house meeting.
examples.zh: 我用「延时启动」功能，这样每周室友开会时洗碗机就不会运行。

words.enDefinition: a washing option for fewer items than the machine's capacity

examples.en: With only three plates in the dishwasher, my roommate chose the half load setting.
examples.zh: 洗碗机里只有三个盘子，室友选了「半载洗涤」设置。

examples.en: We asked whether the half load option was available on both racks of this model.
examples.zh: 我们问，这个型号上下两层碗架都能用「半载洗涤」选项吗？

words.enDefinition: a program stage that washes away residue using water

examples.en: The display showed that the rinse cycle had almost finished after we cleared the table.
examples.zh: 我们收拾好桌子后，显示屏上显示「漂洗程序」快结束了。

examples.en: My housemate thought the rinse cycle was the final stage, but drying was still to come.
examples.zh: 室友以为「漂洗程序」是最后一步，后面其实还有烘干。

words.enDefinition: rinse dishes briefly before beginning the main wash

examples.en: We don't usually pre-rinse the plates before putting them into the new dishwasher.
examples.zh: 我们用这台新洗碗机时，通常不先「预冲洗」盘子。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether she should pre-rinse the bowls after scraping off the leftovers.
examples.zh: 室友问，刮掉剩菜之后要不要先「预冲洗」这些碗。

words.enDefinition: a program stage that removes moisture from washed items

examples.en: The glasses were still damp because we opened the door before the drying cycle ended.
examples.zh: 杯子还是湿的，因为「烘干程序」还没结束我们就开了门。

examples.en: Our dishwasher has a quiet drying cycle that runs after the last rinse.
examples.zh: 我们家的洗碗机有个很安静的「烘干程序」，在最后一次漂洗后启动。

words.enDefinition: a rotating dishwasher part that sprays water across the racks

examples.en: The tall plate was too close to the spray arm, so I moved it sideways.
examples.zh: 高盘子太靠近「喷水臂」，我把它挪到旁边了。

examples.en: The manual shows a separate spray arm for the two levels inside our dishwasher.
examples.zh: 说明书上画着我们洗碗机里上下两层各自的「喷水臂」。

collocations: leave room for the spray arm

words.enDefinition: a screen that collects food particles inside a dishwasher

examples.en: The instructions show where to find the dishwasher filter in our particular model.
examples.zh: 说明书画出了我们这个型号的「洗碗机滤网」在哪里。

examples.en: I noted a little food residue in the dishwasher filter after unloading the dishes.
examples.zh: 取出餐具后，我发现「洗碗机滤网」里有少量食物残渣。

words.enDefinition: a dishwasher designed to be fitted into kitchen cabinetry

examples.en: The flat had a built-in dishwasher, which left more room on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 公寓配了「嵌入式洗碗机」，厨房台面就更宽敞了。

examples.en: We checked whether the built-in dishwasher was included in the list of supplied appliances.
examples.zh: 我们查了「嵌入式洗碗机」在不在随房电器清单里。

collocations: a kitchen with a built-in dishwasher

words.enDefinition: a dishwasher that stands separately from fitted kitchen cabinets

examples.en: The landlord suggested a freestanding dishwasher because there was no space inside the existing cabinets.
examples.zh: 原来的橱柜里面没有空位，房东建议用「独立式洗碗机」。

examples.en: We left a gap next to the cabinets for the freestanding dishwasher the landlord ordered.
examples.zh: 我们在橱柜旁给房东订的「独立式洗碗机」留了个空位。

words.enDefinition: a single machine that washes and dries laundry

examples.en: The flat came with a washer dryer combo because there's no room for separate machines.
examples.zh: 公寓配了「洗烘一体机」，因为没地方分开放两台。

examples.en: I asked how much the washer dryer combo could dry before putting in both sets of sheets.
examples.zh: 把两套床单都放进去之前，我问了「洗烘一体机」一次能烘多少东西。

words.enDefinition: a machine that dries clothing in a rotating drum

examples.en: Our residence has a tumble dryer downstairs that students can pay to use.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼下有台「滚筒烘干机」，学生可以付费用。

examples.en: I checked the tag before deciding whether this blanket could go in the tumble dryer.
examples.zh: 决定这条毯子能不能放进「滚筒烘干机」之前，我先看了标签。

collocations: put towels in the tumble dryer

words.enDefinition: a washing machine with a door on its front

examples.en: The utility closet is low, so our landlord chose a front-loading washer for it.
examples.zh: 杂物间上方净空不大，房东就选了一台「前开门洗衣机」。

examples.en: The campus laundry has a front-loading washer with enough space for my bedding.
examples.zh: 校园洗衣房有台「前开门洗衣机」，空间够放我的床上用品。

words.enDefinition: a washing machine loaded through an opening on top

examples.en: Our laundry room has a top-loading washer near the window beside the dryer.
examples.zh: 我们洗衣房的「上开盖洗衣机」在窗边，就在烘干机旁。

examples.en: I checked for enough space above the top-loading washer before putting a shelf there.
examples.zh: 往「上开盖洗衣机」上面装架子之前，我先看了下上方预留的空间够不够。

collocations: the lid of a top-loading washer

words.enDefinition: the rotating container where clothes go to be washed

examples.en: I found a single sock at the back of the washing machine drum after unloading everything.
examples.zh: 拿完衣服后，我在「洗衣机内筒」最里面发现一只袜子。

examples.en: The washing machine drum was much larger than I'd expected when I opened the door.
examples.zh: 我打开门一看，「洗衣机内筒」比想象中大多了。

words.enDefinition: a sliding tray that feeds detergent into a washing machine

examples.en: The instructions show which part of the detergent drawer is for the main wash.
examples.zh: 说明书上标明了「洗衣液抽屉盒」哪个格子用于主洗。

examples.en: My roommate showed me the detergent drawer because I'd never used this model before.
examples.zh: 我以前没用过这种型号，室友指给我看了「洗衣液抽屉盒」在哪里。

collocations: the main compartment of the detergent drawer

words.enDefinition: the section of a detergent tray for liquid softener

examples.en: The flower symbol marks the fabric softener compartment on the washer in the downstairs laundry.
examples.zh: 楼下洗衣房那台机器上，花朵图标标出了「柔顺剂专用槽」。

examples.en: I mistook the fabric softener compartment for the detergent slot the first time I used this washer.
examples.zh: 第一次用这台洗衣机时，我把「柔顺剂专用槽」误认成了洗衣液槽。

collocations: the fabric softener compartment in the drawer

words.enDefinition: one small packet of detergent that dissolves in water

examples.en: My flatmate offered me a detergent pod because I'd run out of laundry liquid.
examples.zh: 我的洗衣液用完了，室友给了我一颗「洗衣凝珠」。

examples.en: I keep one detergent pod in my laundry tote when I go downstairs to wash clothes.
examples.zh: 下楼洗衣服时，我会在装衣服的袋子里放一颗「洗衣凝珠」。

words.enDefinition: how fast a washer drum rotates to remove water

examples.en: I used a lower spin speed for the sweater I'd just washed by itself.
examples.zh: 刚才单独洗那件毛衣时，我选了较低的「脱水转速」。

examples.en: The display shows the spin speed next to the water temperature for each program.
examples.zh: 每个程序的显示界面上，水温旁边就是「脱水转速」。

words.enDefinition: an additional rinse selected after the regular wash stages

examples.en: My roommate selected extra rinse after noticing soap left on the towels last time.
examples.zh: 室友上次发现毛巾还有洗衣液残留，这次选了「额外漂洗」。

examples.en: The washer has an extra rinse option beside the temperature button on the display.
examples.zh: 这台洗衣机的显示面板上，温度按钮旁边有一个「额外漂洗」选项。

words.enDefinition: a wash program with less movement to protect fabrics

examples.en: The label recommends the gentle cycle, so I kept the blouse away from my jeans.
examples.zh: 衣标建议用「轻柔洗程序」，我就没把这件衬衫和牛仔裤放一起。

examples.en: I washed my scarf on the gentle cycle before hanging it in my room.
examples.zh: 我用「轻柔洗程序」洗了围巾，然后把它挂在房间里。

words.enDefinition: a washing program designed for machine-washable wool items

examples.en: My flatmate used the wool cycle for a sweater with a machine-washable care label.
examples.zh: 室友用「羊毛洗程序」洗了件衣标上注明可机洗的毛衣。

examples.en: I hadn't noticed the wool cycle until I looked through the machine's program menu.
examples.zh: 翻了洗衣机的程序菜单后，我才注意到有「羊毛洗程序」。

words.enDefinition: a wash using cold water instead of heated water

examples.en: I chose a cold wash for the T-shirts because their labels specified cold water.
examples.zh: 这些 T 恤的衣标上写明要用冷水，所以我选了「冷水洗」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the short program could also run as a cold wash.
examples.zh: 室友问，短程序能不能也选「冷水洗」。

words.enDefinition: a preliminary washing stage before the main cleaning program

examples.en: I selected a prewash for the muddy clothes I wore on our hike.
examples.zh: 徒步时穿的衣服沾了泥，我就选了「预洗」。

examples.en: The machine's display showed the prewash had finished and the main program was starting.
examples.zh: 洗衣机显示「预洗」已经结束，主洗程序正在启动。

collocations: use a prewash for muddy clothes

words.enDefinition: a stronger wash program for sturdy and heavily soiled items

examples.en: We picked the heavy-duty cycle after coming back from a very muddy volunteer cleanup.
examples.zh: 参加志愿清理活动时蹭得都是泥，回来后我们选了「重污洗程序」。

examples.en: I checked the care label before using the heavy-duty cycle for my work trousers.
examples.zh: 用「重污洗程序」洗我的工作裤之前，我先确认了衣标。

words.enDefinition: a wash setting designed for sheets or other bulky bedding

examples.en: I used the bedding cycle when I washed all my sheets after the guests left.
examples.zh: 客人走后，我用「床品洗程序」把床单都洗了一遍。

examples.en: My flatmate showed me the bedding cycle on the new washer when I brought down my blanket.
examples.zh: 我拿着毯子下楼时，室友给我指了新洗衣机上的「床品洗程序」。

words.enDefinition: a mesh bag that protects delicate items during machine washing

examples.en: I put my thin scarf in a delicates bag before starting the gentle wash.
examples.zh: 启动轻柔洗之前，我把薄围巾放进了「细软衣物洗护袋」。

examples.en: My roommate keeps a delicates bag next to the washer for her delicate clothes.
examples.zh: 室友在洗衣机旁边放了个「细软衣物洗护袋」，专门用来装不好直接机洗的衣服。

collocations: put lace in a delicates bag

words.enDefinition: a screen that catches fibers released while clothes dry

examples.en: I checked the lint trap before using the shared dryer, as the sign asked.
examples.zh: 我按提示牌上的要求，先检查了「绒屑过滤网」，再用共用烘干机。

examples.en: The residence put a label near the lint trap so new students could find it.
examples.zh: 宿舍在「绒屑过滤网」旁贴了标签，方便新生找到它。

words.enDefinition: reusable balls placed with laundry to separate items while drying

examples.en: We use dryer balls so the towels don't bunch together in the shared machine.
examples.zh: 我们用「烘干球」，让毛巾在公用烘干机里不至于结成一团。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps a pair of dryer balls in the basket next to the dryer.
examples.zh: 室友在烘干机旁边的篮子里放了两个「烘干球」。

words.enDefinition: a mode that uses moisture levels to determine drying time

examples.en: I chose sensor dry so the dryer could stop once the shirts were dry.
examples.zh: 我选了「感应烘干」，衬衫一干，烘干机就能自动停下来。

examples.en: The campus dryer has sensor dry and a separate option for choosing the run time.
examples.zh: 学校烘干机有「感应烘干」，还可以另选按时长烘干。

words.enDefinition: a drying program that runs for a selected duration

examples.en: I picked timed dry for an extra ten minutes because the towels felt slightly damp.
examples.zh: 毛巾摸起来还有点潮，我用「定时烘干」又加了十分钟。

examples.en: My roommate selected timed dry instead of the automatic program shown on the left.
examples.zh: 室友选了「定时烘干」，没有选左边显示的自动程序。

collocations: use timed dry for another round

words.enDefinition: a dryer that reuses warmed air through a heat pump

examples.en: The landlord chose a heat pump dryer for our flat and left its manual on the counter.
examples.zh: 房东给我们公寓选了台「热泵烘干机」，把说明书放在台面上了。

examples.en: My roommate asked if the new heat pump dryer would fit beside the washing machine.
examples.zh: 室友问，新「热泵烘干机」放不放得下洗衣机旁边的空位。

collocations: compare a heat pump dryer with a vented model

words.enDefinition: a dryer that sends warm moist air through a vent

examples.en: Our old flat had a vented dryer connected to a duct through the wall.
examples.zh: 我们原来住的公寓有台「排气式烘干机」，连着一根穿墙的管道。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether a vented dryer was suitable for the available laundry space.
examples.zh: 顾问问，现有洗衣空间是否适合放「排气式烘干机」。

collocations: a vented dryer with an exhaust duct

words.enDefinition: a dryer that collects moisture as liquid water

examples.en: We looked at a condenser dryer because the laundry room has no outside vent.
examples.zh: 洗衣房没有通往室外的排气口，所以我们看了看「冷凝式烘干机」。

examples.en: My housemate checked the manual to see how our condenser dryer collects water.
examples.zh: 室友查了说明书，想了解我们的「冷凝式烘干机」怎么收集冷凝水。

collocations: an appliance manual for a condenser dryer

words.enDefinition: an appliance container that holds water for use or collection

examples.en: The water reservoir on my roommate's coffee machine lifts out for easy filling.
examples.zh: 我室友的咖啡机「储水槽」可以取下来，加水很方便。

examples.en: The dryer displayed a message about the water reservoir after I dried my towels.
examples.zh: 我烘干毛巾后，烘干机显示了一条关于「储水槽」的提示。

words.enDefinition: a feature preventing accidental operation of buttons or doors

examples.en: I noticed that the child lock icon was lit on the washer's control panel.
examples.zh: 我注意到洗衣机面板上的「童锁」图标亮着。

examples.en: My roommate checked the owner's manual to find out where the child lock setting was.
examples.zh: 室友查了使用说明书，想知道「童锁」设置在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: the surface containing an appliance's controls and indicators

examples.en: I could see the program name right on the control panel of our washer.
examples.zh: 我直接在洗衣机的「控制面板」上就能看到程序名称。

examples.en: The control panel was above the door, within easy reach when I loaded things.
examples.zh: 「控制面板」在门上方，我往机器里放东西时很容易够到。

words.enDefinition: a sound indicating that an appliance program has finished

examples.en: I heard the end-of-cycle signal from upstairs and went down to get my laundry.
examples.zh: 我在楼上听到「程序结束提示音」，就下楼取洗好的衣服。

examples.en: The new dryer gives a softer end-of-cycle signal than the one in my old residence.
examples.zh: 新烘干机的「程序结束提示音」比我旧宿舍里那台轻柔。

words.enDefinition: a feature that turns a device off without user input

examples.en: I chose a coffee machine with auto shut-off because the old one lacked that feature.
examples.zh: 旧咖啡机没有「自动关机功能」，所以我选了台带这个功能的。

examples.en: The manual explains when auto shut-off happens after the toaster oven finishes its program.
examples.zh: 说明书解释了台式烤炉的程序结束后，什么时候会触发「自动关机功能」。

words.enDefinition: a low-power state in which a device remains available

examples.en: The display went dark after the coffee machine entered standby mode at the end of breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐结束时咖啡机进入「待机模式」，显示屏暗了下去。

examples.en: The manual explains how long the appliance remains in standby mode when nobody is using it.
examples.zh: 说明书介绍了没人用的时候，电器会在「待机模式」下保持多久。

words.enDefinition: a function that measures and dispenses detergent automatically

examples.en: My roommate chose a washer with auto-dose to make sharing the machine easier.
examples.zh: 我室友选了带「自动定量投放」的洗衣机，大家用起来更方便。

examples.en: I checked the display to see whether auto-dose was active on the selected program.
examples.zh: 我看了一眼显示屏，确认选中的程序有没有启用「自动定量投放」。

words.enDefinition: an electric fan elevated on a vertical support stand

examples.en: Our pedestal fan stood next to the sofa during a hot week in September.
examples.zh: 九月有一周很热，我们把「落地式风扇」放在了沙发旁边。

examples.en: I wanted a pedestal fan that could reach above the edge of my desk.
examples.zh: 我想要一台高度能超过桌沿的「落地式风扇」。

words.enDefinition: a tall, narrow fan that moves air through vertical openings

examples.en: I bought a tower fan because there was little floor space between the beds.
examples.zh: 两张床之间的地面不宽敞，所以我买了台「塔式风扇」。

examples.en: The tower fan sat beside the window when our shared sitting room got warm.
examples.zh: 公用客厅暖起来时，那台「塔式风扇」就放在窗边。

collocations: a tower fan for the bedroom

words.enDefinition: an electric fan designed to fit in a window opening

examples.en: My roommate measured the window before choosing a window fan for our upstairs flat.
examples.zh: 给楼上的公寓选「窗式风扇」前，我室友先量了窗户。

examples.en: The window fan brought in the cooler evening air after a hot afternoon indoors.
examples.zh: 下午屋里热了一阵，晚上「窗式风扇」把凉快的空气送了进来。

collocations: a window fan for the kitchen

words.enDefinition: a blanket with electrical elements that produce heat

examples.en: My sister gave me an electric blanket when I moved into a colder room.
examples.zh: 我搬进较冷的房间时，姐姐给了我一条「电热毯」。

examples.en: The shop showed me an electric blanket with separate settings for each side of the bed.
examples.zh: 店员给我看了一条「电热毯」，床的左右两边可以分别调节。

collocations: the controller for an electric blanket

words.enDefinition: a machine that removes excess moisture from indoor air

examples.en: We used a dehumidifier in the room where our laundry was drying indoors.
examples.zh: 在室内晾衣服的那个房间里，我们用了「除湿机」。

examples.en: The landlord lent us a dehumidifier after noticing damp air in the basement flat.
examples.zh: 房东发现地下室公寓空气潮湿，就借给我们一台「除湿机」。

words.enDefinition: a movable cooling unit usually vented through a window

examples.en: I borrowed a portable air conditioner during the hottest week of my summer course.
examples.zh: 暑期课程最热的那个星期，我借了台「移动空调」。

examples.en: We checked where the hose would go before renting a portable air conditioner for our room.
examples.zh: 给房间租「移动空调」之前，我们先看了排风管能从哪里伸出去。

collocations: a portable air conditioner with a hose
fit a portable air conditioner in a room

words.enDefinition: a cooling unit that fits into a window opening

examples.en: The apartment had a window air conditioner when we moved in during the summer term.
examples.zh: 我们夏季学期搬进去时，公寓配有一台「窗式空调」。

examples.en: Our window air conditioner was beside the desk, so I moved my chair farther away.
examples.zh: 「窗式空调」就在书桌旁，我把椅子挪远了一点。

collocations: measure for a window air conditioner
a room with a window air conditioner

words.enDefinition: a device that cools air by evaporating water

examples.en: I saw an evaporative cooler in the shop but wasn't sure it suited our damp flat.
examples.zh: 我在店里看到一台「蒸发式冷风机」，但不确定它适不适合我们潮湿的公寓。

examples.en: Our old evaporative cooler was easy to move between the kitchen and the living room.
examples.zh: 我们原来那台「蒸发式冷风机」在厨房和客厅之间搬来搬去很方便。

collocations: an evaporative cooler with a water tank

words.enDefinition: an electric heater that blows warm air using a fan

examples.en: We borrowed a fan heater for the spare room during a spell of cold weather.
examples.zh: 天气冷的那段时间，我们给备用房间借了一台「暖风机」。

examples.en: The fan heater was louder than I'd expected, so I could hear it from the hallway.
examples.zh: 「暖风机」比我预想的响，在走廊上都听得见。

collocations: the controls on a fan heater

words.enDefinition: a portable electric heater that warms sealed oil inside it

examples.en: The landlord provided an oil-filled radiator for the study where we revised for exams.
examples.zh: 房东在我们复习备考的书房里配了一台「充油式电暖器」。

examples.en: I checked how wide the oil-filled radiator was before bringing it into my room.
examples.zh: 把「充油式电暖器」带进我房间前，我先看了一下它有多宽。

words.enDefinition: a filter designed to capture very small airborne particles

examples.en: I checked the package to see if the HEPA filter fit our air purifier.
examples.zh: 我看了包装，确认这块「高效空气滤网」能不能装在我们家的空气净化器上。

examples.en: The salesperson showed us where the HEPA filter sat inside the demo vacuum cleaner.
examples.zh: 店员指给我们看展示用吸尘器里的「高效空气滤网」在哪儿。

collocations: an appliance with a HEPA filter

words.enDefinition: a device that removes particles from air indoors

examples.en: We placed the air purifier in the living room because that's where we study together.
examples.zh: 我们把「空气净化器」放在客厅，因为我们都在那里一起学习。

examples.en: My roommate asked which air purifier the previous tenant had left behind in the flat.
examples.zh: 室友问，前租客留在公寓里的「空气净化器」是哪一款。

words.enDefinition: a light or display showing when a filter needs attention

examples.en: The filter indicator turned orange, so I looked up the recommended replacement filter.
examples.zh: 「滤网状态指示灯」变成橙色，我就去查推荐的替换滤网。

examples.en: I hadn't noticed the small filter indicator when we bought the vacuum cleaner secondhand.
examples.zh: 我们买二手吸尘器时，我没有注意到那个小小的「滤网状态指示灯」。

words.enDefinition: a setting reducing noise or lights for overnight use

examples.en: The air purifier dims its lights when I choose sleep mode before going to bed.
examples.zh: 我睡前选「睡眠模式」时，空气净化器会把指示灯调暗。

examples.en: I could barely hear the fan after my housemate switched it to sleep mode.
examples.zh: 室友把风扇切到「睡眠模式」后，我几乎听不到声音。

words.enDefinition: repeated side-to-side movement that spreads airflow from a fan

examples.en: The fan has oscillation, so it can send air across both desks.
examples.zh: 这台风扇有「摇头功能」，可以吹到两张书桌。

examples.en: My roommate turned off oscillation because she wanted the airflow aimed directly at her.
examples.zh: 室友想让风直吹自己，于是关掉了「摇头功能」。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which a fan blows air

examples.en: We lowered the fan speed so we could hear the film from the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们调低了「风速档位」，这样在沙发上就能听清电影。

examples.en: The remote lets me change the fan speed without getting out of my chair.
examples.zh: 有了遥控器，我不用从椅子上起来就能换「风速档位」。

collocations: set the fan speed to low

words.enDefinition: a detachable container where a bagless vacuum collects dirt

examples.en: The dust cup was almost full after I vacuumed our living room rug.
examples.zh: 我吸完客厅地毯，「集尘杯」已经快满了。

examples.en: My roommate could see how much dust had collected in the clear dust cup.
examples.zh: 室友透过透明「集尘杯」看得见里面积了多少灰。

words.enDefinition: a bag that holds debris picked up by a vacuum

examples.en: We bought the wrong dust bag because our vacuum has an older model number.
examples.zh: 我们的吸尘器型号老，买错了「集尘袋」。

examples.en: The landlord left an extra dust bag on the shelf with the vacuum manual.
examples.zh: 房东在放吸尘器说明书的架子上留了一个备用「集尘袋」。

words.enDefinition: a vacuum cleaner powered by a rechargeable battery

examples.en: We chose a cordless vacuum because the stair landing has no nearby power outlet.
examples.zh: 楼梯平台附近没有插座，所以我们选了「无线吸尘器」。

examples.en: My roommate used the cordless vacuum to pick up crumbs near our breakfast table.
examples.zh: 室友用「无线吸尘器」清掉了早餐桌附近的碎屑。

words.enDefinition: an automatic vacuum cleaner that travels across the floor

examples.en: I picked my bag up before the robot vacuum started cleaning the living room.
examples.zh: 「扫地机器人」开始清洁客厅前，我把包拿起来了。

examples.en: Our robot vacuum sometimes changes direction when it sees chair legs in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们的「扫地机器人」在厨房遇到椅腿时，有时会掉头。

words.enDefinition: a small vacuum cleaner held and operated by hand

examples.en: I used a handheld vacuum to pick up crumbs that had fallen between the cushions.
examples.zh: 我用「手持吸尘器」把掉在坐垫缝里的碎屑吸走了。

examples.en: The handheld vacuum is light enough to carry from my room to the stairs.
examples.zh: 这台「手持吸尘器」够轻，从房间拎到楼梯那儿不费劲。

words.enDefinition: a narrow attachment for vacuuming small spaces and gaps

examples.en: My flatmate used the crevice tool to reach the gap beside the fridge.
examples.zh: 室友用「吸尘器缝隙吸嘴」清理了冰箱旁边的缝。

examples.en: I found the missing crevice tool in the box of spare attachments under our sink.
examples.zh: 我在水槽下放备用配件的盒子里，找到了先前找不到的「吸尘器缝隙吸嘴」。

collocations: use the crevice tool around the edges

words.enDefinition: a floor cleaner that uses hot steam to loosen dirt

examples.en: My housemate borrowed a steam mop for the tiled floor in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 室友为公用厨房的瓷砖地借来一把「蒸汽拖把」。

examples.en: I checked the floor type before deciding whether to buy a steam mop for our flat.
examples.zh: 决定要不要给公寓买「蒸汽拖把」之前，我先查了地板的材质。

collocations: a steam mop for sealed flooring

words.enDefinition: an appliance using steam to smooth wrinkles from hanging clothes

examples.en: I borrowed my roommate's clothes steamer to smooth my shirt before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前，我借了室友的「挂烫机」把衬衫烫平。

examples.en: The clothes steamer fit in our cupboard even though there was little space left.
examples.zh: 橱柜里没剩多少位置，不过还是放得下这台「挂烫机」。

words.enDefinition: an iron that uses steam to remove wrinkles from fabric

examples.en: I borrowed a steam iron to press my trousers before the presentation at university.
examples.zh: 去学校做展示前，我借了个「蒸汽熨斗」把裤子熨了一下。

examples.en: My flatmate bought a compact steam iron that fits on the laundry shelf.
examples.zh: 室友买了个小巧的「蒸汽熨斗」，正好放得下洗衣区的架子。

collocations: iron clothes with a steam iron
